normalization_plan.reason: minter is only a temporary carrier of msg.sender before it is written to accountTokens inside mintFresh
mintAmount is consumed entirely by the mint accounting performed in mintFresh
redeemTokens only feeds the supply/balance decrement logic in redeemFresh
borrowAmount only feeds the borrow state updates in borrowFresh
repayAmount only feeds the repayment math in repayBorrowFresh
addAmount is only used to size the reserve increase in _addReservesFresh
reduceAmount is only used to size the reserve decrease in _reduceReservesFresh
receiver is only the destination of the doTransferOut performed by _reduceReservesFresh
newPendingAdmin is immediately stored into pendingAdmin by _setPendingAdmin
newComptroller is immediately stored into comptroller by _setComptroller
spender only indexes the transferAllowances write executed by approve
src only identifies the debited account inside transferFrom
dst only identifies the credited account inside transfer/transferFrom
tokens is the amount consumed by the transferTokens accounting
borrower is used across the liquidation path and converges in liquidateBorrowFresh
liquidator is the beneficiary of the liquidation executed in liquidateBorrowFresh
seizeTokens is the amount moved by the seizeInternal balance updates
newReserveKeeper is immediately stored into reserveKeeper by _setReserveKeeperFresh
newInterestRateModel is immediately stored into interestRateModel by _setInterestRateModelFresh
account only indexes the accountBorrows read performed by borrowBalanceStoredInternal
newReserveFactorMantissa is immediately stored into reserveFactorMantissa by _setReserveFactorFresh
cTokenCollateral is only used to make the external collateral calls in liquidateBorrowFresh
payer is only the source of the doTransferIn performed by repayBorrowFresh
redeemer only identifies the account burned and paid in redeemFresh
redeemTokensIn only selects the token-denominated redemption branch of redeemFresh
redeemAmountIn only selects the underlying-denominated redemption branch of redeemFresh
newPendingImplementation is immediately stored into pendingComptrollerImplementation
amount only sizes the external token transfer that constitutes the unsafe operation
from is only the source address of the doTransferIn external call
to is only the destination address of the doTransferOut external call
startingAllowance is a purely internal intermediate value of transferTokens
allowanceNew is a purely internal intermediate value of transferTokens
srcTokensNew is a purely internal intermediate value of transferTokens
dstTokensNew is a purely internal intermediate value of transferTokens
currentBlockNumber is only the block.number snapshot used by accrueInterest
accrualBlockNumberPrior is only the cached storage read used by accrueInterest
borrowRateMantissa is exactly the untrusted return value of the interest rate model call
blockDelta is an internal accrual intermediate computed in accrueInterest
simpleInterestFactor is an internal accrual intermediate computed in accrueInterest
actualMintAmount is the direct result of the external transfer in the mint path
allowed is exactly the policy hook return value that gates the mint/market operations
error is only the accrueInterest return code propagated by the internal entry functions
